{{Otheruses|Abandoned}}
The '''abandoned smelting plant''' was a rusting structure on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]] formerly owned by [[Raynor Mining Enterprises]]. 

It was built by Raynor at the eastern feet of the [[Ragnook Mountains]], for extracting [[ore/Legends|ore]] (with a complex mining system) and producing smelted metal. Some of those resources were used to build a huge [[Metal/Legends|metallic]] platform as foundation of a new [[city/Legends|city]]. 

The reserves of the planet suddenly ran out, and Raynor went bankrupt. When the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]] bought and colonised the planet, they had no interest in the plant; it had been abandoned and fallen into disrepair.

Some years before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[whiphid/Legends|whiphid]] [[Spearmaster]] [[Rathleek]] with [[Rathleek's hunting band|a band]] of twenty [[hunting/Legends|hunters]] came to Kothlis and hunt in the [[Arblis Forest]], and settled into the plant, making it their base.
